best_idea: Let a finger own its press, so a fight button stays held until that same finger lifts even after it slides off, and split a release into a tap (under 200 ms and 30 units of travel) or a long press that does the secondary action.
decision_why: The finger-owned press and the tap or long-press split fit phone fight buttons (fire, dodge, jump); the crosshair aim servo has a copy error and an aim mapping that does not invert the launch formula, so it is not taken as written.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone, a finger that presses Attack keeps it held until that same finger lifts even if it slides off the button; a tap under 200 ms with under 30 px of travel targets an enemy, while a longer press on Jump does the long jump.
